verdict: Yes, and the timing is good. Jewel Box pitched lab-grown diamond jewellery on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal from all five sharks. Lab-grown diamond prices have fallen sharply, and Surat has become a global centre for growing and cutting them.
angle: Lab-grown diamonds are chemically the same as mined diamonds and cost a fraction of the price. Young buyers see them as an ethical, affordable choice. Certification, clear labelling as lab-grown and good design are essential for trust.

faq_extra.a: Yes. They are chemically and physically the same as mined diamonds, but grown in a lab. They must be clearly disclosed as lab-grown and are usually certified by labs such as IGI.
